_doc: Round 47 MODULAR Screen 05 layout (tools/mod05). World: water surface y = 0, the drum's axis runs along -z, x = right. Every module below is ONE shape reused along the section. Camera / drum / Benny / coin sizes = the measured fit of the approved picture (tools/screenkit/screens/05/fit05.py, round 46 values). The layout (gentle S, one paddle per side per section, foam clusters along both banks) follows the user's round-47 preview.
title: FLOW INTO THE CURRENT

section._note: one module = one wall piece (2.6 u) + one gold ring + two paddles

level._note: the short playable section: ~14 s at speed 2.2; the tunnel continues to the bright end so the view is never cut

route._note: ONE gentle S: centre x(z) = axis + amp sin(2 pi d / wavelength), d = distance from Benny's start, eased in

paddle._note: D-shaped gold slab, straight edge on the wall, tilted toward the tunnel centre; angles alternate per section
